structural_blueprint.purpose: Bind repository roots, runtime zones, capability planes, physical ownership, state authority, composition roots, and recovery domains into one validator-enforced structural model.

levels.name: repository-root
levels.rule: A top-level live owner must be declared in canonical_roots before it can own runtime behavior.

levels.name: runtime-zone
levels.rule: Zones define legal dependency direction and forbidden ownership.

levels.name: capability-plane
levels.rule: Every construction plane is placed exactly once in one runtime zone.

levels.name: ownership-unit
levels.rule: Each plane has one materialized canonical owner inside its assigned zone.

levels.name: contract-surface
levels.rule: Cross-boundary behavior is explicit, versionable, testable, and receipt-bearing where authority changes.

composition_roots.responsibility: Compose declared runtime services and operator topology; never absorb domain business logic.
Dispatch operator commands into owned engine/application surfaces without creating alternate runtimes.
Mount application routes, middleware, and shared application dependencies; feature logic remains in owned modules.
Mount product providers, guards, and navigation shell; service ownership remains behind canonical API clients.
Construct credential-bearing runtime provider adapters after governance, admission, and architecture receipt checks.
Own canonical provider capability/budget routing below the application boundary; no provider credentials.
Application compatibility and telemetry-policy surface during routing convergence; it may consume engine routing contracts but cannot own canonical model-routing state.

recovery_domains.degraded_mode: fail closed for authority-bearing work; health may remain diagnostic-only
deny or route only to already-declared healthy capacity; never bypass receipts or budgets
bounded stateless mode only where the request contract permits it; never cross tenant boundaries
checkpoint, cancel, or return partial evidence; never silently repeat side effects
health and explicit unavailable responses; resumable operations preserve identity and terminal state
preserve local UI state and surface backend/engine degradation without fabricating completion
fail closed for protected actions and external transfers
freeze promotion and learning mutation while preserving current known-good release

invariants: acceptance edges are explicit and never participate in the runtime zone DAG
every construction plane is placed exactly once
plane owner equals the construction contract owner

execution_hosts.responsibility: Host engine-owned request, policy, state-adapter, worker, and evidence planes without changing their ownership.

runtime_lifecycle.derivation: service lifecycle follows the runtime DAG; explicit groups are validated against dependency order and must not create hidden service dependencies
readiness_rules: a runtime node is not ready until every declared dependency is ready
liveness proves process survival; readiness proves dependency-safe request admission
degraded readiness must be explicit and cannot claim unavailable capability as healthy
provider credentials do not make provider-backed capabilities ready unless architecture receipt and provider preflight succeed
product readiness requires both application and engine endpoints used by the shell

shutdown_groups.action: stop new user mutations and preserve bounded resume state
stop application admission, drain requests and streams
stop engine admission, checkpoint or terminalize operations, flush evidence
fence writers, flush durable state, then stop stores

runtime_lifecycle.shutdown_rule: reverse runtime dependency order; consumers drain before dependencies stop
upgrade_rules: validate architecture/construction/provider/app contracts before mutating installed runtime
run persistence migrations before starting code that requires the new schema and retain rollback compatibility evidence
replace stateless service replicas only after readiness of replacement capacity
drain durable workers before incompatible code replacement
never upgrade a dependency underneath a consumer that has not been drained or proven compatible
rollback uses the last release evidence pointer and must preserve durable state compatibility
crash_rules: restart only within the owning recovery domain unless a dependency health failure requires broader restart
terminal operation state is never reopened by process restart
realtime reconnect resumes from durable cursor or returns explicit resync
ambiguous durable writes fail closed and require recovery evidence
policy/security/governance failure blocks protected work rather than bypassing the plane

relationship_semantics.runtime_dependency: Implementation dependency that participates in the zone DAG and topological construction order.
relationship_semantics.acceptance_target: Evidence/contract target observed by a validator or release plane without an implementation dependency.
relationship_semantics.composition: Assembly-time wiring between already-owned capabilities; never transfers ownership.
